author: 2BJ
body:
Client UUID (that you were banned on): ltGm8I/ZE3Afe7aTEIK2ilKV06M= 
Type of Punishment (if ban, name how long the ban is): Permanent 
Reasoning to why your ban should be appealed: The original punishment I 'evaded' was invalid. (The original punishment I recieved, a thirty minute tempban for cursing in a cursing forbidden channel, was not valid. The player who punished me is no longer a staff member. He does not have valid evidence to prove this punishment was valid. I did not realize I was ban evading whilst connecting to the Teamspeak server on a different platform ( my phone ) about 26 minutes later as it successfully connected to the server although I was connecting from within the same IP. I apologize for ban evading regardless, however, the original infraction is not valid.

title: Emilizzle - TS Appeal

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hey Emilizzle.

Even though the first punishment was considered "invalid" (by you),  you should have appealed at that time when you were punished. You have also decided to ban evade a lot more after that. We will not tolerate that. If you want to be unbanned, you need to stop evading and wait 6-8 months.

Regards,
ProfessorUtonium
